verdict.rationale: Temporal's self-hosted guide documents configuring retention per Namespace and archiving closed Workflow Histories and Visibility records to blob storage for longer retention. The CLI and Cloud extension can manage Namespaces, so users have some control over how long data is kept. Explicit deletion controls are not evidenced, and the retention support rests on one-line doc mentions. Missing for 10: documented on-demand deletion of workflow executions or namespaces, detail on retention period limits and enforcement, Temporal Cloud retention and deletion policy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
